gameDescriptionHtml:
Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a noir-style 3D side-scrolling action game where you play as a vampire lady, strategically switching between her vampiric and human forms. Engage in high-speed high-risk combat using blood as your ultimate resource.

To find your long-lost sister, you must obey a mysterious broker and navigate a conflicted world. At the end of this bloody path lies your sister, a conspiracy, or… maybe hope?

“Pure Blood” Combat – Dual Forms​​: Blood is power! The bloodthirsty Scythe Form consumes HP for swift kills, while the tactical Cane Form allows HP recovery and stun. Focus & Skills​​: Unleash stylish yet practical attack skills to overwhelm enemies with relentless combo chains. Relentless Foes​​: Enemies track you across terrain and will relentlessly pursue you once combat begins. Break & Execute​​: Shatter enemy defenses through skill combos, then deliver instant-execution finishers.
“Blood-Tears” Story – While searching for your sister, you receive a message from an enigmatic broker. To uncover her whereabouts, you must accept broker’s missions. In a modern world torn by human-demon race conflict, you – a vampire – confront brutal realities. The broker, your sister, gangs… This isn’t just about them. This is also about you, and… yourself

Game Features

  • Aether Frenzy – During combat, enemies may occasionally enter a Frenzied state. Frenzied enemies become more powerful and can unleash Frenzy Skills.
  • Execution – When different types of Aether Frenzy enemies use their Frenzy Skills, a flash will appear in their eyes. Hitting them with the corresponding weapon skill will put them in an [Execution-ready] state. Press Attack to automatically perform an execution.
  • Skill Learning – As you progress, unlock a wide variety of skill modules!
